themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that can autonomously conduct research tasks, including planning, execution, and analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, often acting as a pair programmer.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or personas for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Explores AI capabilities in condensing large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of evaluating the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the analysis of user feedback, comments, and reviews to gauge sentiment and identify key themes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications that directly aid in the design process and various research methodologies.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications designed to create, distribute, and analyze surveys, often with intelligent question generation or data interpretation.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights a broad category of AI-powered platforms and tools specifically built to support various research activities.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Investigates the impact of AI on job markets, recruitment processes, and the skills needed for future employment.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
